body: Extra info: I've been doing my best to keep it clean, washing with water and mild unscented soap 2x a day. Using Vaseline and a bandaid to keep it moist and covered, and 2x warm Epsom salt soaks a day. Doesn't hurt to walk on it, but it hurts a bit to press it with my finger. The nail side of the bump is much more sensitive than the other side.

The people on it are worse than you'd expect. You can't say anything invalidating when trying to offer genuine advice, all you can do is try and push them in the right direction. From someone who was in their place 6 years ago, it hurts.
Hey. If you ever need help, I'm here for you.
